text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight safely completed her debut.
Without setting any major target races for now, we decided
on a policy of carefully building up her physical condition first—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff...—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Phew...
choice_data_list: Alright, let's take a break!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Shall we increase the weight for the next set?
I might be able to handle a little bit more!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She's growing day by day, too... However, given her constitution, I'd rather avoid methods that push her to her absolute limits. I understand her motivation, but here—
choice_data_list: Let's wait until we're a bit more used to it.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, that's right!
Understood!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oooooh~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Drawn by the loud shouting, I looked over and saw
Winning Ticket and Yukino Bijin.
Both are Umamusume from the same generation as North Flight.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, that was incredible, Yuki-chaaan!!
You set a new personal best!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, that barbell was pretty heavy...
but I'm glad I managed to lift it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm!
You've really gotten so strong...!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
N-No way, no way! I've only
completed one goal so far...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Before I reach the Classic Year, I gotta get stronger an' stronger!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, that's right!
This is no time to be getting emotional!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yuki-chan is on the Triple Tiara route, and I'm on the Classic Triple Crown route! Our dreams are waiting for us!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are two main paths for Classic-year girls to challenge:
the Triple Tiara route and the Classic Triple Crown route.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The Tiara route consists of the Oka Sho, Yushun Himba, and Shuka Sho, while the Classic Triple Crown route consists of the Satsuki Sho, Japanese Derby, and Kikuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because they are races you can run only once in your life,
they hold deep emotional value for the Umamusume, their staff, and the fans.
They are truly momentous races.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Our paths may be different, but our desire to win is the same!
I'm not gonna lose either!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Allllriiiight, it's decided!!
I'm gonna do 100 squats--!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: With Yuki-chan on my back!! Our combined heat makes it twice as effective--!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wha-whaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
P-Please wait! In that case...
I'll go pack on some weight with wanko soba!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu.
choice_data_list: They're such energetic kids.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Right! But it's not just that... it feels like both of them have grown even more than before.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Debuting around the same time,
we've been pushing each other to be better...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
What a wonderful bond.
Truly...
choice_data_list: (...A flight?)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...Right then!
I'll get ready for the next one!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight headed toward equipment mainly used by trainees before their debut.
She is still using those machines.
choice_data_list: (Of course she'd care about it, wouldn't she...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that everyone around her is growing so rapidly...
Unlike before her debut,
it wouldn't be strange for impatience to set in.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Someone who can push and grow alongside her at the same level.
If only she had someone like that right now—
choice_data_list: (Maybe I should try talking to that person—)

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
"Does that mean...
I'm not good enough, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
'There's no need to limit it to Uma Musume, is there?
Even if you can't compete under the same physical load,
you should be able to compete with her on equal footing.'

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
"...It brings back memories, somehow.
I used to think along similar lines in the past, after all."

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
"If Fuu-chan's doing her best all alone,
I want to be right beside her, cheering her on...!"
choice_data_list: What did you do?

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
North Flight
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer-sanâ

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Wait, um... Are you okay?
You kind of look like you have dark circles under your eyes...?
choice_data_list: I-I'm fine...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After talking with North Flight's "Big Sister" yesterday...
preparations took so long that I ended up pulling an all-nighter until morning.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Please don't push yourself too hard.
So... what did you want to talk about?
choice_data_list: Question 1!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Um, excuse me.
choice_data_list: How many meters is one furlong?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
About 200 meters... in international feet,
it is precisely 201.168 meters, to be exact.
choice_data_list: Correct! Question 2: What are the characteristics of European turf?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...It is mainly used at European racecourses.
Because of its high water retention and low elasticity,
it generally makes for a track that demands power."
choice_data_list: Correct! Question 3—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: P-Please wait!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Umm... what's the matter?
All of a sudden...
choice_data_list: Because I wanted to compete against you.
I wanted to compete with you.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: A challenge...?

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text:
"Fu-chan and I would often quiz each other
about running.
She always loved putting her mind to work, you see."

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text: "Bring three things you need for a race... Simple tasks like that, but I hoped it would help her learn something during the period she couldn't run."

text_block_list.name: "Big Sister"
text_block_list.text: "Before long, she started playing quiz games with her juniors too... Having fun as she grew, step by step."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can't compete with North Flight in running.
However, if it's a battle of wits...
With enough effort, I can push her as an equal.
choice_data_list: With this, I can be your rival!
With this, I can be your rival!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...You took me by surprise.
It felt like a pop quiz!"
choice_data_list: True, that doesn't really feel like a quiz, huh...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Well then, how about something like this?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to quizzes, it seems I'm the big sister...
So I'll ask a question too!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If we're rivals,
we've gotta compete against each other... right?
choice_data_list: !! Gladly!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes, leave it to me♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thank you,
Trainer-san...—
choice_data_list: Flight, anytime you're ready!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
Well then... how about something like this?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Daitaku Helios was the winner of last year's Mile Championship, but... the winning time was—
choice_data_list: 1 minute 34.8 seconds!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ohh!
Was it too easy?
choice_data_list: I've got plenty of knowledge about mile racing stored up!
I've got plenty of knowledge about mile racing stored up, you know!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Then I'll challenge it with my very best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, North Flight and I continued quizzing
each other after that... deepening each other's
knowledge along the way.
